# jsonW (json Wondrous)

> jsonW is a data format for the AI era: one file that is at once JSON-compatible text, a columnar store like Parquet, a
> vector index for semantic search and a permission layer. The same data has three lossless forms: row (binary, real time),
> column (the .jsw file, mmap, zero-copy) and text (jsonW-text; every valid JSON is valid jsonW-text). It has business types
> (money with ISO 4217 currency, unit-aware measures, exact decimals, byte-exact codes), embeddings and tensors, and 19
> built-in features: term (IDF) and semantic (cosine) search, multilinear grid, scoring requests, top-k, block zones,
> dictionary, key index, Aho-Corasick lexicon, live writing, edit/delete with history, permission views, custody, partial
> remote read over HTTP Range, similar spelling and sound in pt/en/es/zh, audio, text and video signals, per-block and
> per-tenant columns. Post-quantum transport. Zero-dependency C core by Wortic (wortic.com.br), free to use inside products
> under the jsonW Sustainable Use License 2.0 (proprietary, not open source). Current version 2.0.0. Site: https://jsonw.org

## Key facts
- Measured 2026-11-13 with 1.3.11 (100k synthetic records, median of 10 runs, vs. JSONL read by jsonW's own JSON reader):
  6.6x smaller than uncompressed JSONL; 2,310x faster to read one whole column. Compressed JSONL (zstd, xz) is smaller than
  the default level on that very repetitive data.
- Real data (Brazil INPI trademark base, 55.3 million rows, 12.53 GB of CSV): 4.9x smaller than the CSV (6.5x at the maximum
  level), 12.8x smaller than the XML; .jsw at the maximum level is 1.2x the size of Parquet. 8-core Parquet (DuckDB 2.0.0)
  still reads faster on two of three column queries (1.6x and 3.5x); jsonW reads with one core today.
- Key lookup (1.3.13): 0.196 ms median in a 1-million-row file after `indexar`, versus 142.8 ms scanning.
- Node.js 22.12+ and TypeScript: `npm install @wortictecnologia/jsonw` (prebuilt for macOS arm64 and Linux x64; ESM
  `import` and `require`; generic types in index.d.ts; `jsonw` CLI). Server-side in Next.js, Remix, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit,
  NestJS, Express.
- Browser, React Native, Deno, Bun and edge (1.3.14): `import { carregar } from "@wortictecnologia/jsonw/wasm"` runs the same
  C core as WebAssembly (193 KB) and opens a .jsw from bytes: rows, search, key lookup, scoring, custody check. Read-only;
  writing stays on the server. React Native (Hermes) uses the `polywasm` implementation.
- SDKs for 15 languages over a stable C ABI: C, C++23, Python 3.10+, Node.js, PHP 8.4+ (Composer, Laravel, WordPress),
  Ruby 4, Go, Rust 2024, Java 22+, Kotlin, Swift 6, Dart (Flutter), Objective-C (iOS, macOS) and COBOL (GnuCOBOL).
  Tool `wjsw` and `libjsonw` for macOS arm64, Linux x86_64 and ARM64, Windows x86_64.
- Databases: `wcon` converts PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Redis/Valkey and MongoDB to .jsw and back with no loss
  (schema from each column's type; numeric stays exact decimal; pgvector becomes vf32/vf16). `wremoto` reads a .jsw on R2,
  S3 or HTTP by Range, downloading only the needed blocks.
- RAG without a vector database: a `vf16[768]` column plus `avaliar` with `{"cosseno": {"campo": "v", "consulta": [...]}}`
  returns the top k rows by cosine, combinable with term search and filters.
- Permissions inside the format: signed credential (HMAC-SHA256, constant-time, nonce + sequence), column scopes
  (`+escopo(x)`, `+pessoal`), row isolation by integer `tenant`, cell = both. Hidden data never leaves the server.
- Post-quantum: jsonW-fio over QUIC + TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768 (Wortic server); remote reads (wremoto) over HTTPS + TLS 1.3 with the same hybrid by default; custody and credentials use 256-bit hashes/HMAC.
- The schema and CLI use Portuguese words: texto (text), dinheiro (money), medida (measure), codigo (exact code), tempo
  (time), dic (dictionary text), qualquer (any JSON); ver (view), conferir (verify), filtrar (filter), calcular
  (aggregate), comparar (diff), avaliar (score/top-k), escolher (top-k of a column), reconhecer (classify).
- Compared with JSON, CSV, Parquet, Arrow, MessagePack and Protobuf, only jsonW combines a text form, a columnar file, money
  and units, typed embeddings with in-file search, per-credential permissions and tamper-evident custody in one format.

- [README (Português)](https://github.com/developer-wortic/jsonw/blob/main/README.pt-BR.md): visão geral em português
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/developer-wortic/jsonw/blob/main/AGENTS.md): exact rules, types and commands for AI coding agents
- [docs/JSONW.md](https://github.com/developer-wortic/jsonw/blob/main/docs/JSONW.md): full reference of types, schema, tool, guarantees and security
- [sdk/README.md](https://github.com/developer-wortic/jsonw/blob/main/sdk/README.md): SDK per language and the byte-for-byte test
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wortictecnologia/jsonw): Node.js and TypeScript
